measures.description: Measures to compute per group; at least one. Accepted values: `count`, `error_count`, `error_rate` (share from 0 to 1), `duration_avg`, `duration_p50`, `duration_p90`, `duration_p95`, `duration_p99`, `duration_max` (milliseconds, spans only) and `sum:<attribute key>` for a numeric attribute. step_ms.description: Bucket width in milliseconds for a per-group time series in `buckets`; omit for group totals only. Equal to the window length, it yields one bucket per group.

order_by.description: One of the requested measures, optionally followed by ` asc` or ` desc`. Default: the first measure, descending. Examples: `error_rate`, `duration_p95 desc`, `count asc`.
